camera.name: Camera module supplier (Arducam / UCTRONICS / Seeed)
camera.ask: Quote an IMX219 M12-mount camera board at 1 / 100 / 1 000, with and without lens, plus a 22-pin 0.5 mm MIPI CSI FFC at ~15 mm. Seeed's 102110719 is the only line with a published tier (10+ at $12.50) - extend it to 100 and 1 000. For the lens (B7) specifically: we cannot choose one until the FOV is fixed, so quote by FOV ON A 1/4-INCH SENSOR and state the barrel outside diameter, which must not exceed 16.9400 mm (measured off Pollen's own lens mesh, out/verify/mech_dims.json). The two lenses we priced - Arducam M40180H13L at 14.7000 mm across and The Pi Hut LN007 at 20.0000 mm across - bracket that limit, and the second fails it.
also_ask: Does B0183 ship WITH the M12 lens? UCTRONICS' package list says yes; The Engineer Store's page for the same SKU says the lens is separate.
What is the shortest 22-pin 0.5 mm FFC you make? We need ~15 mm and no catalogue part that short was findable.
For each M12 lens you quote: the barrel outside diameter and total length in mm, and the diagonal / horizontal / vertical FOV measured on a 1/4-inch sensor.
